foodie.title: Long Lunch at Icebergs Dining Room
foodie.description: Take a window table above the Bondi pool and let a plate of pasta and a bottle stretch into the afternoon.
foodie.bonus: Stay for one more course than you planned.

foodie.title: The Tasting Menu at Quay
foodie.description: Eat a long, precise, harbour-facing menu at the table with the best view of the bridge in Australia.
foodie.bonus: Put the phone in your bag for the entire meal.

foodie.title: Gelato at Messina, Darlinghurst
foodie.description: Join the late-night queue for rotating specials chalked up daily by the country's most obsessive gelato lab.
foodie.bonus: Order the weirdest special on the board.

foodie.title: Morning Pastry at Bourke Street Bakery
foodie.description: Queue at the Surry Hills corner shop for a sausage roll and a ginger brûlée tart eaten standing on the footpath.
foodie.bonus: Order two things and eat the second one slowly.

foodie.title: Filter Coffee at Single O Surry Hills
foodie.description: Drink at one of the roasteries that made Sydney coffee a global export, in a room that still feels like a workshop.
foodie.bonus: Ask what's on filter today and take their word for it.

foodie.title: Natural Wine at Love, Tilly Devine
foodie.description: Squeeze into a Darlinghurst laneway bar named after a razor-gang madam and drink whatever the list is excited about.
foodie.bonus: Order a glass of something from a country you can't place.

foodie.title: Pho Crawl Through Cabramatta
foodie.description: Ride the train southwest to Sydney's Vietnamese heart and eat your way down John Street, one bowl per stop.
foodie.bonus: Order in Vietnamese at least once.

foodie.title: Sashimi Breakfast at the Sydney Fish Market
foodie.description: Eat raw tuna and Sydney rock oysters at 7am surrounded by the trade doing its actual business.
foodie.bonus: Eat one thing you can't identify.

foodie.title: Saturday Morning at Carriageworks Farmers Market
foodie.description: Fill a tote bag with produce, coffee, and pastries at Carriageworks' Saturday farmers market.
foodie.bonus: Buy breakfast from a stall you've never tried.

foodie.title: Fish and Chips at Doyles on the Beach
foodie.description: Eat fish and chips with your toes in the sand at Doyle's, Sydney's original waterfront seafood shack.
foodie.bonus: Eat with your hands, no cutlery.

foodie.title: Dumpling Crawl Through Haymarket
foodie.description: Crawl through Haymarket's Chinatown for dumplings, one steaming basket at a time.
foodie.bonus: Order in Mandarin or Cantonese if you can, even just 'thank you.'

foodie.title: Tasting Menu at Aria Restaurant
foodie.description: Sit down for a multi-course tasting menu with harbour views at Aria, one of Sydney's finest tables.
foodie.bonus: Order the dish you can't pronounce.

chill.title: Float in the Bronte Bogey Hole
chill.description: Wedge yourself into the natural rock pool at the south end of Bronte and let the swell wash over you.
chill.bonus: Stay in for a full ten minutes without getting out.

chill.title: Sunset Picnic at Barangaroo Reserve
chill.description: Spread out on the sandstone headland the city rebuilt from a container terminal and watch the harbour go pink.
chill.bonus: Stay until the harbour lights come on.

chill.title: Golden Hour at Nielsen Park
chill.description: Take the calmest harbour beach in the east, backed by a shark net and a hundred-year-old changing pavilion.
chill.bonus: Swim once after the sun has gone behind the trees.

chill.title: Ferry to Watsons Bay and a Swim at Camp Cove
chill.description: Ride out to the harbour mouth, swim in flat clear water, then walk up to the Gap for the ocean on the other side.
chill.bonus: Take the ferry both ways instead of the bus back.

chill.title: Wendy's Secret Garden, Lavender Bay
chill.description: Wander a garden one woman built into an abandoned rail yard out of grief, terraced down to the water in secret paths.
chill.bonus: Find a bench nobody else has found and sit on it.

chill.title: The Cremorne Point Foreshore Walk
chill.description: Ferry across and follow the flat path around the point past harbour pools, fig trees and million-dollar views for free.
chill.bonus: Walk the whole loop without checking a map.

chill.title: Spa Afternoon at The Darling
chill.description: Book a treatment and a long sit in the vitality pool and steam rooms at Pyrmont's quietest hotel spa.
chill.bonus: Leave your phone in the locker the entire time.

chill.title: Manly Ferry and Beach Afternoon
chill.description: Take the ferry to Manly and spend the afternoon between the beach and the corner cafes.
chill.bonus: Sit outside on the ferry deck, not inside.

chill.title: Slow Wander Through the Royal Botanic Garden
chill.description: Wander the winding paths of the Royal Botanic Garden with the Opera House peeking through the trees.
chill.bonus: Find the oldest tree you can and read its plaque.

chill.title: Sunset at Mrs Macquarie's Chair
chill.description: Watch the sun drop behind the Harbour Bridge from the sandstone ledge at Mrs Macquarie's Chair.
chill.bonus: Stay until the last color leaves the sky.

social.title: A Night Out at The Ivy
social.description: Move between courtyard, pool deck and dance floor in the George Street complex that runs Sydney's biggest nights.
social.bonus: Dance to one song you'd never admit to liking.

social.title: Rooftop at Coogee Pavilion
social.description: Climb to the top floor of the beachfront pub for plants, ping pong tables and an ocean view over the balcony rail.
social.bonus: Win a game of something before you leave.

social.title: Trivia at the Courthouse Hotel Newtown
social.description: Take a table in the beer garden of Newtown's most democratic pub and lose a quiz to a table of locals.
social.bonus: Name the team something you'd be embarrassed to hear read out.

social.title: Small Bar Crawl Through Surry Hills
social.description: Work down Crown and Bourke Streets through the tiny licensed rooms that rewrote how Sydney drinks.
social.bonus: One drink per bar, no repeats, no exceptions.

social.title: Sunset Sessions at Watsons Bay Beach Club
social.description: Get a jug and a table on the lawn where the harbour faces due west and the whole terrace turns to watch.
social.bonus: Take the ferry home instead of a taxi.

social.title: Beers at the Lord Nelson Brewery Hotel
social.description: Drink house-brewed ale under sandstone walls in a Rocks pub that has been pouring since the 1840s.
social.bonus: Try the tasting paddle and pick a favourite out loud.

social.title: New Year's Eve from Blues Point Reserve
social.description: Claim a patch of grass on the north shore early and watch the bridge go off over the water at midnight.
social.bonus: Get there before lunch and hold the spot all day.

social.title: Live Music at the Enmore Theatre
social.description: Stand on the sloped floor of Sydney's best mid-size room, a 1908 picture palace that never stopped putting on bands.
social.bonus: Get there early enough to catch the support act.

social.title: Pickup Beach Volleyball at Bondi
social.description: Jump into a pickup beach volleyball game on the sand at Bondi.
social.bonus: Join a game already in progress instead of starting your own.

social.title: Pub Trivia at The Rose Hotel
social.description: Grab a table at The Rose Hotel and go head-to-head at Chippendale's weekly pub trivia night.
social.bonus: Team up with a table you don't already know.

adventure.title: Bouldering at Sydney Indoor Climbing Gym
adventure.description: Work problems in a converted St Peters warehouse until your forearms give out.
adventure.bonus: Finish a route two grades above your comfort level.

adventure.title: The Giant Stairway to the Three Sisters
adventure.description: Take the train to Katoomba and walk 900 steel steps down a cliff face into the Jamison Valley rainforest.
adventure.bonus: Walk back up instead of taking the railway.

adventure.title: Ferry and Ruins Walk on Cockatoo Island
adventure.description: Take the ferry to a UNESCO-listed convict prison and shipyard in the middle of the harbour and wander the empty dry docks.
adventure.bonus: Walk into the darkest tunnel you can find.

adventure.title: Cycle the Centennial Park Grand Drive
adventure.description: Loop the 3.6km ring road past ponds, paperbarks and horse riders in the city's big green lung.

adventure.title: Snorkel with Weedy Seadragons at Clovelly
adventure.description: Drop into the sheltered rock channel and hunt for the strangest, most delicate fish in Australian water.
adventure.bonus: Stay in until you actually find one.

adventure.title: Whale Watching Out Through the Heads
adventure.description: Head out past North and South Head on a cruise timed to the humpback migration and wait for a breach.
adventure.bonus: Stay on the open deck the whole trip, however rough it gets.

adventure.title: Sunrise Hike to Barrenjoey Lighthouse
adventure.description: Climb the headland track at the very top of the northern beaches and watch the sun come up over Pittwater and the ocean at once.
adventure.bonus: Take the steep Smugglers Track up, not the service road.

adventure.title: Swim the Ocean Pool at Wylie's Baths
adventure.description: Do laps in a 1907 tidal pool bolted to the rocks at Coogee, with waves breaking over the edge as you turn.
adventure.bonus: Swim a full lap without stopping.

adventure.title: Surf Lesson at Manly Beach
adventure.description: Get pushed into your first green wave on the gentlest good learning break in the city.
adventure.bonus: Stand up on a wave before the lesson ends.

adventure.title: Sunrise Swim at Bondi Icebergs
adventure.description: Swim laps in the famous ocean-fed pool at Bondi Icebergs as the surf crashes just beyond the wall.
adventure.bonus: Do one full lap without stopping.

adventure.title: Kayak Under the Harbour Bridge
adventure.description: Paddle a kayak beneath the girders of the Harbour Bridge with the whole harbour opening up around you.
adventure.bonus: Paddle directly under the bridge and shout something up at it.

adventure.title: Stand-Up Paddleboard Rose Bay to Shark Island
adventure.description: Paddleboard from Rose Bay out to Shark Island and back across calm harbour water.
adventure.bonus: Paddle to Shark Island and back without sitting down once.

adventure.title: BridgeClimb Sydney Harbour Bridge
adventure.description: Harness up and climb the arches of Sydney Harbour Bridge for a bridge's-eye view of the Opera House and skyline.
adventure.bonus: Wave at the Opera House from the top.

adventure.title: Bondi to Coogee Coastal Walk
adventure.description: Follow the clifftop trail from Bondi to Coogee, dipping into ocean pools along the way.
adventure.bonus: Stop at every ocean pool along the way, even just to dip your feet.

adventure.title: Snorkel the Gordons Bay Nature Trail
adventure.description: Snorkel the underwater nature trail at Gordons Bay, marked out for you rock to rock.
adventure.bonus: Follow the underwater trail markers the whole way without cutting the loop short.

adventure.title: Hike the Spit Bridge to Manly Walkway
adventure.description: Hike the Spit Bridge to Manly Scenic Walkway, a coastal trail packed with harbour lookouts.
adventure.bonus: Finish with a swim at Manly Beach, no matter how tired you are.

culture.title: Contemporary Art at the MCA, Circular Quay
culture.description: Ride the lifts up an art deco building for changing Australian and international shows, then take the rooftop harbour view.
culture.bonus: Find one piece you actively dislike and work out why.

culture.title: A Play at Belvoir St Theatre
culture.description: Watch new Australian writing in a corner theatre in Surry Hills where the stage juts into the audience on three sides.
culture.bonus: Book the show with the title you understand least.

culture.title: Afternoon at the Art Gallery of New South Wales
culture.description: Cross between the old sandstone wing and the new glass pavilion, ending in a WWII oil tank buried under the gardens.
culture.bonus: Go straight to the Tank first and work backwards.

culture.title: Stand-Up at the Sydney Comedy Store
culture.description: Sit in a proper purpose-built comedy room at Moore Park where the country's touring headliners work out new hours.
culture.bonus: Sit close enough to be heckled.

culture.title: Aboriginal Heritage Tour in the Royal Botanic Garden
culture.description: Walk the harbour foreshore with a First Nations guide reading the land as Gadigal country, not parkland.
culture.bonus: Learn one plant use and remember it a week later.

culture.title: A Night at the Sydney Opera House
culture.description: Take a seat inside the sails for opera, orchestra or ballet in the room the whole city is named for.
culture.bonus: Arrive an hour early and have a drink on the forecourt steps.

culture.title: Megafauna and Minerals at the Australian Museum
culture.description: Meet a diprotodon skeleton and a room of glowing minerals in the country's oldest museum.
culture.bonus: Pick the animal you'd least like to meet alive.

culture.title: A Day on the Hill at the SCG
culture.description: Watch cricket or footy at the Sydney Cricket Ground, where the old Members Pavilion still stands over the outfield.
culture.bonus: Stay for the whole innings, however it's going.

8ball.title: Tarot Reading at Glebe Markets
8ball.description: Get your cards read by a tarot reader at the Saturday Glebe Markets.
8ball.bonus: Ask the reader one question you actually want answered.

8ball.title: Golden Hour on the Manly Ferry
8ball.description: Ride the Manly Ferry at golden hour and just watch the city slide by.
8ball.bonus: Don't take a single photo — just watch.
